integrity: Complete analytical proof and independently computed Markov-generator-moment and lagged-correlation checks; these finite checks are corroboration and not a proof of the infinite parameter claim. Forward moment frameworks are credited. Priority risk from other specialized inverse literature remains.
scientific_limitations: Exact stationary statistics of symmetric telegraph-modulated positive diffusivity under a known linear trap and known lag. Unordered diffusion states only; finite-sample reliability, nonsymmetric switching and parameter stability near excluded boundaries are not proved.
title: Stationary energy-correlation tomography of a switching-temperature harmonic trap
